overview_description.description:
Enode is accelerating the transition to a sustainable energy system by connecting and optimizing the world’s energy devices. 

Enode’s APIs enable companies to instantly connect users’ energy devices — including EVs, solar inverters, home batteries and thermostats — to their app. With a few lines of code, Enode saves businesses months of integration and ongoing maintenance, cutting the cost and complexity out of building energy management apps.

about_short_description.short_description: Enode is accelerating the transition to a sustainable energy system by connecting and optimizing the world’s energy devices.

product.name: Connect API
product.description: A single API that enables integration and control of over 1000 energy devices including EVs, solar inverters, home batteries, thermostats, and more.

product.name: Optimize APIs
product.description: APIs providing algorithms and endpoints for smart charging, scheduling, and energy device insights to optimize energy consumption and costs.

product.name: Aggregate APIs
product.description: APIs that aggregate and manage flexible loads from connected energy devices to participate in flexibility markets and create Virtual Power Plants (VPPs).

product.name: Smart Charging
product.description: A use case enabled by Enode’s APIs that automatically shifts EV charging to off-peak periods to reduce costs and balance grid demand.

product.name: Demand Response
product.description: A service that connects and controls residential energy devices to reduce or shift electricity consumption during peak times to balance the grid.

product.name: E-mobility APIs
product.description: APIs providing real-time EV data such as state of charge, location, and charging status to support e-mobility applications like route planning and public charging.
